title: IVG Pro 2 Prefilled Pod Kit
description: The IVG Pro 2 Prefilled Pod Kit range offers a variety of bold and refreshing flavours, delivering a smooth and satisfying vape in a convenient, easy-to-use format. Designed for performance and simplicity, this advanced prefilled pod system combines long-lasting hardware with IVG’s innovative auto-fill technology, creating a low-maintenance solution for vapers who want reliable all-day flavour. At the heart of the kit is the IVG Pro 2 device, powered by a powerful 1000mAh built-in battery designed for extended use between charges. A standout feature of this generation is the modern touch-screen display, which provides a clear and intuitive battery level indicator so you can quickly check your power status. The device uses auto-draw activation, removing the need for buttons and delivering a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping experience. The kit operates using IVG’s intelligent auto-fill pod system, pairing a 2ml prefilled pod with a 10ml refill reservoir, both containing 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid. Once connected and inserted into the device, the refill container automatically supplies e-liquid to the pod as you vape. This system removes the need for manual refilling or coil changes while offering up to 10,000 puffs per kit, depending on personal usage. Equipped with mesh coil technology, the IVG Pro 2 delivers consistent vapour production and rich flavour from the first puff to the last, making it a convenient and flavour-packed choice for everyday vaping. Running low? There’s no need to replace the whole kit — just stock up on IVG Pro 12 refill pods . With 15 bold flavours to choose from, it’s easy to keep your vape fresh and satisfying: IVG Pro 2 Kit Flavours • Fizzy Cherry Sweet Cherry flavour with a sparkling, soda-style finish. • Blue Raspberry Ice Tangy Blue Raspberry paired with a crisp icy exhale. • Blue Sour Raspberry Sharp Blue Raspberry with a tangy sour twist. • Classic Menthol Clean, cooling Menthol with a smooth refreshing finish. • Pineapple Ice Juicy tropical Pineapple lifted by a cool icy layer. • Lemon Lime Bright Lemon blended with zesty Lime for a sharp citrus vape. • Spearmint Fresh, sweet Spearmint flavour with a cooling minty finish. • Strawberry Watermelon Sweet Strawberry combined with juicy Watermelon. How to Set Up your IVG Pro 2 Prefilled Pod Kit: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping. Shop IVG Pro 12 Refill Pods
